summary: Former wooden Ocala National Forest tower, no more than 40 ft, along FR 9 North; no footings remain; registered 2017; county differs between sources.

facts.design: wooden tower, no more than 40 feet tall
facts.status_note: Register calls it a former tower; no footings remain, only possible wooden debris

events.note: Registered January 23, 2017, nominated by Bob Spear

evidence.supports: former wooden tower no more than 40 feet tall
evidence.quote: This former wooden tower was no more than 40 feet tall.

evidence.quote: No footings remain of this tower which stood in northern Ocala National Forest along FR 9 North.

evidence.supports: possible wooden debris at the site

evidence.quote: In descending order of land area, it is located in parts of Marion , Lake , and Putnam counties.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved. Register says Alachua County, Florida; Wikipedia lists Marion, Lake and Putnam as the counties holding parts of the forest. The story reports both and the brief's value is left unchanged for editor review.

notes_for_editor: One register page carries the substance; Wikipedia is used only for the county disagreement. Two web searches found nothing on the tower's build date, builder, staffing, fires or public access. Story is short (about 160 words) because the record is short. No photos found.
